_comment: Provider template — FILENAME=ROUTE (bigmodel: the credential+endpoint channel; token var derives from it). `_family` = MODEL LINEAGE (glm) — the same/different-family judgment unit (model-routing.md). `model` = the pinned per-generation id, never part of the filename. Route: BigModel's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic). FAMILY = glm — zai / bigmodel / zhipu are brands/platforms of ONE model lineage (the pi/dsh ports' vocabulary; their pi-adapter route for the same lineage is zai-coding-cn). EXAMPLE of a user-authored provider extension: copy this file to profiles/<name>.json, set routing + <UPPERCASE-NAME>_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (convention; override via `_token_env`); no code change. See model-routing.md. ADR #40.
